source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 모두 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Freeze an independently authored, complex adult fashion photograph before consulting downstream project data. The supplied portrait guides visible adult appearance only, while the authored scene makes a wind-driven draped garment, physically connected folds, and a clearly one-sided change in satin brightness inspectable in the final image.
subject: One adult woman with long dark near-black hair in loose waves and a near-center part, restrained natural makeup, a composed closed-mouth expression, and a calm direct gaze. The supplied portrait serves solely as visible adult appearance guidance for an original subject. She is shown full length with her left foot planted, right foot crossing forward, torso turning toward the camera, left hand securing cloth at her waist, and right arm held slightly away from her silhouette.
setting: The open stern vehicle deck of a working car ferry underway before sunrise: a damp blue-gray steel floor, one broad diagonal yellow lane stripe, muted red structural ribs, a waist-high safety rail, two secured chain coils, and thin sea fog beyond the stern opening. The subject stands left of center in a clear lane, with open space to frame right and a physically consistent crosswind moving from frame left to frame right.
event: The photograph catches the subject midway through a controlled pivot as the crosswind loads a deep copper-red silk-satin mantle gown. A shoulder-fastened panel rises into a broad S-curve and streams toward frame right, while a second panel gathered at the left waist travels lower across her calves. Tension radiates from the visible shoulder and waist anchors, compression folds collect under her hand, diagonal pull lines connect hip and stepping knee, and her lower hair lengths and the fog follow the same wind direction.
visual_priorities: The copper-red satin shows slim continuous copper-white gleams only on fold faces turned toward the low camera-left work light, with adjacent deep oxblood troughs and softly colored panels as the cloth rolls away from the light.
Both airborne panels read as parts of one constructed gown: every moving ridge and trough can be traced continuously to the left shoulder fastening, left waist gather, hip turn, or bent knee.
The single left-to-right wind direction is visible across both garment panels, the lower lengths of hair, and the sea fog, while the planted foot and waist grip provide readable counterforce.
The entire action is inspectable in one vertical frame containing the head, direct gaze, both feet, shoulder fastening, waist gather, two moving panels, and both hems.
The low three-quarter environmental composition clearly establishes a real predawn ferry deck while leaving the subject and cloth as the dominant visual event.
The image retains cinematic editorial realism through natural skin texture, woven satin detail, crisp major fold ridges, a trace of blur only at the hem tips, and credible damp-deck reflections.
baseline_prompt_en:
Create a vertical 4:5 full-length environmental fashion photograph on the open stern vehicle deck of a working car ferry underway before sunrise. Show one adult woman with long dark near-black hair in loose waves, a near-center part, restrained natural makeup, a composed closed-mouth expression, and a calm direct gaze. Use the supplied portrait solely as guidance for visible adult appearance cues, rendering an original adult subject. Place her left of center with open space to frame right. She is caught midway through a controlled pivot: left foot planted on a diagonal yellow lane stripe, right foot crossing forward, torso rotating toward the lens, left hand securing fabric at her waist, and right arm slightly separated from her silhouette.

Dress her in a deep copper-red silk-satin mantle gown. Its clean sleeveless bias-cut column base supports an asymmetric drape fastened at the left shoulder, crossed over the collarbone, gathered once at the left waist, and divided into two long free panels. A steady sea crosswind travels from frame left to frame right. The shoulder panel forms a broad high S-curve behind her; the waist panel sweeps lower across her calves and curls once near its hem. The shoulder clasp and waist gather remain visible. Continuous tension lines connect each anchor to each flying hem, compression folds collect beneath her waist hand, and diagonal pulls connect her hip to her stepping knee. Her lower hair lengths and thin background fog stream frame right in the same direction. The main body, face, fold ridges, anchors, and shoes are sharply frozen, while the final few centimeters of the flying hems carry a slight directional blur.

Light the gown with one long cool-white deck work light set low and far camera-left, grazing the cloth at a shallow angle. Render slim continuous copper-white gleams along fold faces turned toward that light; let each gleam lengthen along a ridge, then disappear as the fold rolls into a deep oxblood trough. Broad panels angled across the light remain softly copper-red. The garment reads as dense, fluid woven silk satin with broad continuous folds and physically connected fabric from anchor to hem. A small amber navigation lamp behind camera-right adds a restrained edge accent, while dim navy predawn skylight preserves natural facial detail and textured shadows.

Photograph from a low three-quarter viewpoint slightly camera-left at knee height, about 4.5 meters away with a 35 mm full-frame lens, approximately f/4, 1/800 second, ISO 800. Include the complete head, both feet, both anchors, and both hems. Let the damp blue-gray deck, broad yellow stripe, muted red ribs, safety rail, secured chain coils, and foggy stern opening remain legible around an otherwise empty vehicle lane. Finish as a cinematic on-location fashion editorial with fine realistic grain, natural skin texture, crisp cloth micro-contrast, controlled highlights, deep detailed shadows, and physically coherent reflections.
